dct_description_sm: Abstract: Hydro includes hydrographic (water-related) features, including water bodies such as rivers, ponds, and streams greater than 0.5 acres. This is a polygon layer.

Purpose: This polygon data layer is used for the city base map and any detailed mapping. The layer has rarely changed over the years, however recently there has been a modification in the area of North Point Park across from the Museum of Science in East Cambridge.
